coreMemory.chinese: 记得；回想起；记着去做；向……致意；纪念
coreMemory.english: v. to keep a person, place, or experience in your mind；v. to not forget to do something that is needed；v. to give someone a greeting, gift, or special thought
coreMemory.structure: remember to do something /rɪˈmembər ˈtuː ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（记得要做某事）；remember doing something /rɪˈmembər ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（记得做过某事）；remember someone clearly /rɪˈmembər ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈklɪrli/（清楚地记得某人）；remember a name /rɪˈmembər ə ˈneɪm/（记住一个名字）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ remember to meet him yesterday → ✅ remember meeting him yesterday；❌ remind to call me → ✅ remember to call me / remind me to call

commonErrors.note: remember to do 表示记得去做尚未做的事；remember doing 表示记得做过的事

commonErrors.right: remember to call me / remind me to call
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /rɪˈmembər ˈtuː ˈkɔːl ˈmiː riˈmaɪnd ˈmiː ˈtuː ˈkɔːl/
commonErrors.note: remember 的主语是需要记住的人；remind 后必须说明提醒谁

coreMemory.directSynonym: recall /rɪˈkɔːl/（回想起）；recollect /ˌrɛkəˈlɛkt/（忆起）；retain /rɪˈteɪn/（记住；保留）；bear in mind /ˈbɛr ɪn ˈmaɪnd/（牢记）；commemorate /kəˈmɛmɚˌeɪt/（纪念）
coreMemory.example: Remember to save your work before you leave.

meanings.english: to keep a person, place, or experience in your mind

meanings.translation: 我仍然记得我的第一位老师。

meanings.english: to not forget to do something that is needed
to give someone a greeting, gift, or special thought

fixedPhrases.example: Remember to save the document before closing it.
fixedPhrases.translation: 关闭文档前记得保存。

fixedPhrases.example: I remember visiting this museum as a child.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我记得小时候来过这家博物馆。

fixedPhrases.example: She still remembers her first piano teacher clearly.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她仍清楚地记得自己的第一位钢琴老师。

fixedPhrases.example: It took me a moment to remember his name.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我过了一会儿才想起他的名字。

fixedPhrases.example: Remember that the last train leaves at eleven.
fixedPhrases.translation: 记住，末班车十一点开。

fixedPhrases.example: Do you remember where we parked the car?
fixedPhrases.translation: 你记得我们把车停在哪里吗？

fixedPhrases.example: If I remember correctly, the office opens at eight.
fixedPhrases.translation: 如果我没记错，办公室八点开门。

fixedPhrases.example: People remember her as a fearless reporter.
fixedPhrases.translation: 人们记得她是一位无畏的记者。

fixedPhrases.example: The scientist is remembered for her work on vaccines.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这位科学家因疫苗研究而被铭记。

fixedPhrases.example: Maya asked me to remember her to my parents.
fixedPhrases.translation: 玛雅请我代她向我的父母问好。

fixedPhrases.example: This example will help you remember the difference.
fixedPhrases.translation: 这个例子会帮助你记住区别。

fixedPhrases.example: Winning the final made it a day to remember.
fixedPhrases.translation: 赢得决赛使那一天值得铭记。

coreMemory.english: v. to put someone or something in a particular place or position；v. to establish, decide, or adjust a value, rule, goal, or time；v. to cause someone or something to enter a state；v. to move below the horizon
coreMemory.structure: set something somewhere /ˈsɛt ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈsʌmˌwɛr/（把某物放在某处）；set a goal /ˈsɛt ə ˈɡoʊl/（设定目标）；set a deadline /ˈsɛt ə ˈdɛdˌlaɪn/（设定截止日期）；set a date /ˈsɛt ə ˈdeɪt/（确定日期）
